name: antevo-strategy-radar
description: What changed today for your company's strategy — Antevo's daily business board of risks and opportunities for companies, from trade, regulation, supply, shipping, energy, demand, currencies, funding, labour, technology, cyber, geopolitics and climate, matched to your company in your own assistant. Five short questions, no figures; your answers never reach Antevo. Possible responses with reasons, never advice. No account required.
